messages:
alex_gonzalez: Hey team, ACME customer reports intermittent 502s + no trace ID in their portal. They say the call failed and the UI shows an error but no request id. Can someone share the minimal steps we should ask them to send so eng can repro?

maria_wu: Quick checklist: tiny curl repro, HAR (if web), SDK logs (session_hash / req_ref), screenshot of network headers, and a debug bundle if they can generate it. Keep it minimal.

alex_gonzalez: Thx. Can you paste a short curl that non-devs can run? customer is non-technical.

maria_wu: Use this pared-down curl — ask them to replace <API_KEY> and paste back the whole output (headers+body):

```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"test trace"}'
```

maria_wu: Tell them to save the full stdout to a file and paste it. We mainly need any response headers (look for x-rw-req or x-rw-trace), HTTP status, and the body.

alex_gonzalez: For web customers who say "I can't find req id" — where in the Console/UI do we tell them to look?

maria_wu: Console -> Activity -> click the failed request row -> top-right there is "Request details". Look for "Trace ID / Session" field. If it's blank, ask for a HAR.

oncall_ryan: Add mobile/webview notes: webviews or embedded proxies often strip headers. Ask them to capture a HAR from the device (Android Chrome remote debugging or iOS Safari web inspector) or a screen-recording of the network tab showing the request. If proxy is involved, ask for the proxy host + timestamp too.

alex_gonzalez: Example HAR guidance for non-dev: how to grab quickly?

maria_wu: Short steps to paste to customer: 1) Open devtools (F12) -> Network tab. 2) Reproduce error. 3) Right-click the failing request -> Save as HAR. 4) Attach HAR file here. Also ask them to note the local time when they hit the failing button (include timezone).

alex_gonzalez: What about SDKs (browser + node + mobile)? Where is the session marker?

maria_wu: SDKs log a small session marker named `session_hash` or `req_ref` in the debug logs. In browser console: `console.debug('rw:session', session_hash)` if enabled. For Node: capture stdout of your app around the call. For mobile: enable verbose SDK logs and look for `session=` entries. If they're using our hosted SDK, the Console -> Debug page can also surface the last session id for recent requests.

oncall_ryan: If they can't run a curl, the absolute minimal thing we need is: 1) exact time (to the minute) + timezone, 2) project/org name + API key suffix (last 6 chars), 3) a screenshot of the failing UI and network headers if possible. With those we can correlate in logs.

alex_gonzalez: Any automated help we can ask them to run? (one-liners)

maria_wu: Another tiny diagnostic they can run (safe, non-prod keys):

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

maria_wu: That returns status and round-trip time. If status != 200 paste it.

alex_gonzalez: If we need a debug bundle, what's the phrasing to use so customers can find the action in Console?

maria_wu: Say: "In Console > Support, click 'Generate debug bundle' for your project and attach the resulting .zip here. If you can't, upload the HAR + the curl output and we can start with that."

alex_gonzalez: Good. Anything about headers/names we should call out explicitly? We keep seeing proxies rename headers.

oncall_ryan: Call out common header names to search for in network tab: `x-rw-request`, `x-rw-trace`, `x-request-id`, `x-correlation-id`. If none exist, it's likely a proxy. Also ask for upstream proxy host + version if known.

maria_wu: One more: ask them to toggle any intermediate CDN or WAF off for a quick repro if they control it — often those inject or drop headers. If they can't, ask for their edge provider name and timestamp so we can check on our side.

support-bot: NOTE: If you attach a HAR or debug bundle, please remove any PII before uploading. See policy: https://internal.redwood/policy/har-upload

alex_gonzalez: Perfect, I'll send this condensed ask to the customer: minimal curl + HAR (if web) or SDK logs (session_hash) + timestamp + api key suffix + screenshot. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

maria_wu: Thanks — ping me if we can't correlate and we'll escalate to runtime logs with the exact minute window.

oncall_ryan: If escalation needed, include region, model, and any quantization setting they used so we can route to the right cluster.
